# v0.17

Released 2026-11-15.

## Highlights

- Launcher UI polish: icon buttons, a new bicycle SVG icon, and the status collapsed into a
  single line with an inline spinner.
- Completed progress tiles are hidden after two seconds; rider cards are compact with
  refreshed avatars.
- README tidied, with removed details moved into the knowledge base.

## Commits

- Tidy the README and document removed details in the knowledge base (ced813a)
- Refresh avatars and compact rider cards (3528136)
- Hide completed progress tiles after two seconds (ac1d4de)
- Use icon buttons in the launcher (2f17bc1)
- Replace launcher icon with bicycle SVG (e40eb13)
- Collapse the launcher status into one line with the spinner inline (024b98e)
